introduction: The model catalog (package `catalog`) learns the provider vocabulary of PRD 14: it lists rows for the `anthropic`, `openrouter` and `ollama` providers, defines per-provider id matching and fallback limits, carries a fixed per-vendor tier table (SIMPLE, STANDARD, ADVANCED) validated at load, and exposes one offline function, `catalog.Select`, that turns a (provider, model, effort) triple into the catalog row and effort a run will use. `catalog.Lookup` and every current caller stay unchanged.

glossary.Selection: The result of `catalog.Select`: canonical `Provider`, `Tier`, `Model` (a deep-copied `core.Model`), `Effort` and `Listed`.
glossary.effort: One of the five `core.Effort` levels low, medium, high, xhigh, max. `Selection.Effort` is the effort to request; whether it reaches the wire is the provider's reading of `Model.Efforts`.
glossary.fallback descriptor: The `core.Model` served for an id the catalog does not list for a provider: that provider's fixed window and output cap, all prices zero, `ThinkingKindAdaptive` and a nil `Efforts` map.
glossary.listed: Whether the resolved model id is a row of the chosen provider in the catalog (`Selection.Listed`).
glossary.provider: One of the three backends this build can run: `anthropic`, `openrouter` or `ollama`. Fixed in Go code; each name equals the catalog vendor id of the same spelling.
glossary.row: A model entry under a vendor in `catalog.json`, turned into a `core.Model` with window, output cap, prices and an `Efforts` map.
glossary.tier: One of the names SIMPLE, STANDARD or ADVANCED. Given as the model string, it picks a model id and an effort for the chosen provider from the catalog's fixed tier table.
glossary.tier table: The optional per-vendor `tiers` object in `catalog.json`, mapping each tier name to `{model, effort}`; fixed per release.

requirements.title: Provider names
requirements.rationale: Every later scope of PRD 14 needs one fixed, case-insensitive set of provider names that only names providers this build can run.

criteria.action: export the constants `ProviderAnthropic = "anthropic"`, `ProviderOpenRouter = "openrouter"` and `ProviderOllama = "ollama"`, and a function `Providers() []string` that returns them in that order as a newly allocated slice on every call
criteria.contract: `Providers()` returns `[anthropic openrouter ollama]`; mutating a returned slice does not change the result of a later call

criteria.condition: `Select` receives a provider name that equals one of the three providers after trimming surrounding whitespace and ignoring case (for example " OpenRouter ")
criteria.action: resolve against that provider
criteria.contract: `Selection.Provider` is the canonical lower-case provider name

criteria.condition: `Select` receives an empty or whitespace-only provider name
criteria.action: resolve against the `anthropic` provider
criteria.contract: `Selection.Provider == "anthropic"`; `Select("", "STANDARD", "")` returns the same Selection as `Select("anthropic", "STANDARD", "")`

criteria.condition: the trimmed, case-folded provider name is not one of the three providers
criteria.action: return an error wrapping `ErrUnknownProvider` whose message names the value as given and the three providers
criteria.contract: zero `Selection`; `errors.Is(err, catalog.ErrUnknownProvider)` is true; for "openai" the message is `agentkit: unknown provider "openai"; known providers are anthropic, openrouter and ollama`

criteria.condition: the provider name equals a vendor id present in a catalog given to `Parse` that is not one of the three providers (for example `azure`)
criteria.action: refuse the vendor as a provider, taking the provider set from code and not from the catalog's vendors
criteria.contract: zero `Selection`; `errors.Is(err, catalog.ErrUnknownProvider)` is true

criteria.condition: `(*Catalog).Select` is called on a catalog returned by `Parse` with a known provider and a model id that is not a tier
criteria.guard: that catalog has no vendor section for the provider
criteria.action: select the provider and serve the provider's fallback descriptor for the id
criteria.contract: nil error; `Selection.Listed == false`; `Selection.Model` is the fallback descriptor of 26-REQ-3.5 to 26-REQ-3.7 for that provider

requirements.title: OpenRouter and Ollama rows in the embedded catalog
requirements.rationale: The facts every provider scope needs (window, output cap, price, efforts) live in the catalog, so a model change is a catalog change.

criteria.action: carry an `openrouter` vendor section with `name` "OpenRouter", `api` "openrouter-chat", `base_url` "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1" and `default_model` "qwen/qwen3.8-flash"
criteria.contract: `Default().KnownVendor("openrouter")` is true and `Default().DefaultModelID("openrouter")` is "qwen/qwen3.8-flash"

criteria.action: list exactly one `openrouter` row, `qwen/qwen3.8-flash`, with `context_window` 1000000, `max_tokens` 131072, cost input 0.15 / output 0.47 / cache_read 0.016 / cache_write 0, `input` ["text"], `reasoning` true, a `thinking_level_map` mapping `low`, `medium`, `high` and `max` each to the same name with `xhigh` absent, and a `note` that names OpenRouter's list of 2026-10-21 as the price source and the efforts probed
criteria.contract: the row's `core.Model` has ContextWindow 1000000, MaxOutputTokens 131072, the four prices above, and Efforts with keys exactly {low, medium, high, max}

criteria.action: carry an `ollama` vendor section with `name` "Ollama", `api` "ollama-chat", `base_url` "http://127.0.0.1:11434" and `default_model` "qwen3.8:27b"
criteria.contract: `Default().KnownVendor("ollama")` is true and `Default().DefaultModelID("ollama")` is "qwen3.8:27b"

criteria.action: list exactly one `ollama` row, `qwen3.8:27b`, with `context_window` 32768, `max_tokens` 32768, all four prices 0, `input` ["text"], `reasoning` true, the same `thinking_level_map` as the OpenRouter row, and a `note` stating that 32,768 is the length run on the reference machine (32 GB Apple M4) rather than the 262,144 `/api/show` reports, that the Ollama provider sends it as `num_ctx`, and that the price is zero because the model runs on the embedder's hardware
criteria.contract: the row's `core.Model` has ContextWindow 32768, MaxOutputTokens 32768, all prices 0, and Efforts with keys exactly {low, medium, high, max}; the note contains "32,768", "262,144" and "num_ctx"

criteria.action: set `catalog_version` to "2026-10-21" and keep `schema_version` 1, with a top-level `note` that still contains the REQ-CAT-06 regeneration ritual and mentions the tier table
criteria.contract: `Default().Version() == "2026-10-21"`; `Default().Note()` contains "REQ-CAT-06" and "tier"

criteria.action: contain no OpenAI or Google section and none of the case-sensitive substrings `gpt-`, `gemini`, `"openai"` or `"google"`
criteria.contract: a byte scan of catalog/catalog.json finds none of the four substrings

criteria.action: keep the `anthropic` vendor fields and its 13 rows unchanged from catalog_version 2026-09-30
criteria.contract: `Default().Models("anthropic")` returns the same 13 ids, and each `Lookup` of them returns the same `core.Model` as before this spec

requirements.title: Model id matching and per-provider fallbacks
requirements.rationale: A vendor model id is case- and prefix-sensitive and a new model must work the day it ships, so ids are matched per provider and unlisted ids are served with a documented guess.

criteria.action: trim surrounding whitespace from a model id that is not a tier and otherwise use it as written, without changing its case
criteria.contract: `Select("openrouter", "  Qwen/X  ", "")` returns `Model.ID == "Qwen/X"`

criteria.condition: the provider is `anthropic` and the model string is not a tier
criteria.action: resolve the id through the existing `Lookup`, accepting and removing a leading `anthropic/`
criteria.contract: `Selection.Model` and `Selection.Listed` equal the two results of `Lookup(model)`; `Select("anthropic", "anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5", "")` returns `Model.ID == "claude-sonnet-5-5"` and `Listed == true`

criteria.condition: the provider is `openrouter` or `ollama` and the trimmed model id names a row of that provider's vendor section
criteria.action: return that row with `Model.ID` set to the id as written
criteria.contract: `Select("ollama", "qwen3.8:27b", "")` returns `Listed == true`, ContextWindow 32768 and MaxOutputTokens 32768

criteria.action: for any provider and any model id, return only a row of that provider's own vendor section, never a row of another provider
criteria.contract: `Select("openrouter", "anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5", "")` returns `Listed == false` and `Model.ID == "anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5"`; `Select("ollama", "qwen/qwen3.8-flash", "")` returns `Listed == false`

criteria.condition: the provider is `openrouter` and the model id is not a row of the `openrouter` vendor
criteria.action: serve the id with the exported constants `OpenRouterDefaultContextWindow = 131_072` and `OpenRouterDefaultMaxTokens = 32_768`
criteria.contract: nil error; `Listed == false`; `Model.ID` is the trimmed id; ContextWindow 131072; MaxOutputTokens 32768

criteria.condition: the provider is `ollama` and the model id is not a row of the `ollama` vendor
criteria.action: serve the id with the exported constants `OllamaDefaultContextWindow = 32_768` and `OllamaDefaultMaxTokens = 32_768`
criteria.contract: nil error; `Listed == false`; `Model.ID` is the trimmed id; ContextWindow 32768; MaxOutputTokens 32768

criteria.condition: the provider is `anthropic` and the model id is not an `anthropic` row
criteria.action: serve the id with the unchanged `DefaultContextWindow` (1,000,000) and `DefaultMaxTokens` (128,000) through `Lookup`
criteria.contract: nil error; `Listed == false`; ContextWindow 1000000; MaxOutputTokens 128000

criteria.action: give every fallback descriptor all four prices zero, `ThinkingKindAdaptive` and a nil `Efforts` map
criteria.contract: for an unlisted id on each provider, the four `*CostPerMillion` fields are 0, `ThinkingKind == core.ThinkingKindAdaptive` and `Efforts == nil`

requirements.title: Tier vocabulary and the embedded tier table
requirements.rationale: A tier name lets an embedder ask for a current model and effort without knowing each provider's model ids.

criteria.action: export a string type `Tier` with the constants `TierSimple = "SIMPLE"`, `TierStandard = "STANDARD"` and `TierAdvanced = "ADVANCED"`
criteria.contract: the three constants have the stated string values

criteria.condition: the whole model string, trimmed, equals one of the three tier names ignoring case (for example " standard ")
criteria.action: treat the model string as that tier and never as a model id
criteria.contract: `Selection.Tier` is the canonical upper-case Tier; a string that merely contains a tier name (for example "STANDARD-1") is treated as a model id with `Tier == ""`

criteria.action: carry an `anthropic` tiers block mapping SIMPLE to `claude-sonnet-5-5` at medium, STANDARD to `claude-sonnet-5-5` at high and ADVANCED to `claude-opus-5-5` at xhigh
criteria.contract: `Select("anthropic", T, "")` returns these model ids and efforts for the three tiers

criteria.action: carry an `openrouter` tiers block mapping SIMPLE, STANDARD and ADVANCED to `qwen/qwen3.8-flash` at low, medium and high respectively
criteria.contract: `Select("openrouter", T, "")` returns these model ids and efforts for the three tiers

criteria.action: carry an `ollama` tiers block mapping SIMPLE, STANDARD and ADVANCED to `qwen3.8:27b` at low, medium and high respectively
criteria.contract: `Select("ollama", T, "")` returns these model ids and efforts for the three tiers

criteria.condition: `Parse` reads a vendor section without a `tiers` key
criteria.action: load the vendor with no tiers
criteria.contract: nil error; the existing test catalog in catalog_test.go, which has no tiers blocks, still parses

requirements.title: Tier block validation at load
requirements.rationale: A tier that points at an unlisted model or silently sends no effort is a hand-editing mistake the catalog rejects at load, like a misspelled level.

criteria.condition: a vendor's `tiers` object has a key that is not exactly `SIMPLE`, `STANDARD` or `ADVANCED`, including a lower-case spelling such as `standard`
criteria.action: reject the catalog
criteria.contract: nil `*Catalog`; `errors.As(err, &*ParseError)` with Path `vendors.<vendor>.tiers.<key>`; `errors.Is(err, ErrCorruptCatalog)` is true

criteria.condition: a vendor's `tiers` object is present but lacks one of the three tier names
criteria.action: reject the catalog
criteria.contract: nil `*Catalog`; `*ParseError` whose Path is `vendors.<vendor>.tiers.<missing tier>`; `errors.Is(err, ErrCorruptCatalog)` is true

criteria.condition: a tier's `model` is empty or is not the id of a row of the same vendor
criteria.action: reject the catalog
criteria.contract: nil `*Catalog`; `*ParseError` whose Path is `vendors.<vendor>.tiers.<TIER>.model` (for example `vendors.ollama.tiers.STANDARD.model`); `errors.Is(err, ErrCorruptCatalog)` is true

criteria.condition: a tier's `effort` is not exactly one of `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` or `max`
criteria.action: reject the catalog
criteria.contract: nil `*Catalog`; `*ParseError` whose Path is `vendors.<vendor>.tiers.<TIER>.effort`; `errors.Is(err, ErrCorruptCatalog)` is true

criteria.condition: a tier's `effort` is absent or null in the named row's `thinking_level_map`, or the named row has no `thinking_level_map`
criteria.action: reject the catalog
criteria.contract: nil `*Catalog`; `*ParseError` whose Path is `vendors.<vendor>.tiers.<TIER>.effort`; `errors.Is(err, ErrCorruptCatalog)` is true

criteria.condition: `Parse` reads a `tiers` block with exactly the three names, each naming a row of the same vendor and an effort that row takes
criteria.action: load the block with `SchemaVersion` still 1
criteria.contract: nil error; `(*Catalog).Select(vendor, tier, "")` returns the block's model and effort

requirements.title: Select entry point and input checking
requirements.rationale: The new entry point fails early on bad input at no cost to existing callers, with errors `agentkit.New` can later return unchanged.

criteria.action: export `func Select(provider, model string, effort core.Effort) (Selection, error)` resolving against `Default()`, and `func (c *Catalog) Select(provider, model string, effort core.Effort) (Selection, error)` resolving against a catalog returned by `Parse`
criteria.contract: `catalog.Select(p, m, e)` returns the same result as `catalog.Default().Select(p, m, e)`

criteria.action: check its inputs in the order provider, then model, then effort, and return the error of the first one that fails
criteria.contract: `Select("openai", "", "bogus")` wraps `ErrUnknownProvider` only; `Select("anthropic", "", "bogus")` wraps `ErrNoModel` only

criteria.condition: the effort, trimmed, equals one of `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` or `max` ignoring case
criteria.action: normalize it to the lower-case `core.Effort` constant
criteria.contract: `Select("anthropic", "claude-sonnet-5-5", " XHigh ")` returns `Effort == core.EffortXHigh`

criteria.condition: the effort is non-empty after trimming and is not one of the five levels
criteria.action: return an error wrapping `ErrUnknownEffort` whose message names the value as given and the five efforts
criteria.contract: zero `Selection`; `errors.Is(err, catalog.ErrUnknownEffort)` is true; the message starts with `agentkit:` and contains the value, low, medium, high, xhigh and max

criteria.condition: the model string is empty after trimming
criteria.action: return an error wrapping `ErrNoModel` whose message names the three tiers and says a model id is also accepted
criteria.contract: zero `Selection`; `errors.Is(err, catalog.ErrNoModel)` is true; the message starts with `agentkit:` and contains SIMPLE, STANDARD, ADVANCED and "model id"

criteria.action: declare `ErrUnknownProvider`, `ErrUnknownEffort` and `ErrNoModel` as distinct sentinel errors whose text starts with `agentkit:`, wrapped by Select with `fmt.Errorf("%w: …")`
criteria.contract: no one of the three matches another or `ErrCorruptCatalog` under `errors.Is`

requirements.title: Selection result and effort precedence
requirements.rationale: Effort precedence is explicit, then tier, then none, and the requested effort is reported as asked so that each provider reads `Model.Efforts` as Anthropic does today.

criteria.action: export a struct `Selection` with the fields `Provider string`, `Tier Tier`, `Model core.Model`, `Effort core.Effort` and `Listed bool`, where `Model.ID` is the id the vendor will receive
criteria.contract: the five fields are accessible to an external package

criteria.condition: the model string is a tier
criteria.action: return the row of the tier's model id with the tier's effort
criteria.contract: `Select("openrouter", "STANDARD", "")` returns Provider "openrouter", Tier "STANDARD", Model.ID "qwen/qwen3.8-flash" with ContextWindow 1000000, MaxOutputTokens 131072 and prices 0.15 / 0.47 / 0.016, Effort "medium", Listed true

criteria.condition: the model string is a tier
criteria.action: return the row of the tier's model id with the given effort in place of the tier's effort
criteria.contract: `Select("ollama", "simple", "HIGH")` returns Tier "SIMPLE", Model.ID "qwen3.8:27b", Effort "high", Listed true

criteria.condition: the provider is `anthropic` or empty and the model string is `STANDARD`
criteria.action: return the `claude-sonnet-5-5` row at effort high
criteria.contract: `Select("anthropic", "STANDARD", "")` and `Select("", "STANDARD", "")` both return Model.ID "claude-sonnet-5-5", Effort "high", Listed true

criteria.condition: the model string is a tier and the provider's vendor section in a catalog given to `Parse` has no tiers block or is missing
criteria.action: return an error naming the provider and the tier
criteria.contract: zero `Selection`; non-nil error whose message starts with `agentkit:` and contains the canonical provider name and the canonical tier name

criteria.condition: the model string is not a tier
criteria.action: return the row or fallback of 26-REQ-3 with an empty tier and the given effort, or an empty effort when none is given
criteria.contract: `Selection.Tier == ""`; `Selection.Effort` is the normalized given effort or `""`

criteria.action: report in `Selection.Effort` the requested effort without filtering or clamping it against `Model.Efforts`
criteria.contract: `Select("ollama", "qwen3.8:27b", "xhigh")` returns Effort "xhigh" while `Model.Efforts` has no `xhigh` key

requirements.title: Select guarantees
requirements.rationale: Select is the offline foundation the provider scopes build on, so it must be cheap, safe and total.

criteria.action: return every `Model` as a deep copy made by `cloneModel`
criteria.contract: mutating `Efforts` values or `Compat` bytes of a returned Model does not change the result of a later identical call

criteria.action: be safe for concurrent use from multiple goroutines
criteria.contract: concurrent calls under `go test -race` report no data race and return the same results as sequential calls

criteria.action: read no environment variable and perform no file or network I/O
criteria.contract: results are identical with `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, `OLLAMA_HOST` and `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` set or unset; package catalog's non-test files import neither `os` nor `net` nor `net/http`

criteria.action: for any provider, model and effort strings against a valid catalog, return without panicking either a non-nil error or a Selection whose `Model.ContextWindow` and `Model.MaxOutputTokens` are positive and whose `Provider` is one of `Providers()`
criteria.contract: a property test over random and adversarial strings (seeded, including Unicode, whitespace and tier-like strings) observes no panic and the stated invariants

requirements.title: Unchanged behaviour and package boundaries
requirements.rationale: 10-REQ-3.3 to 3.6 and every current caller of `Lookup` stay intact; only the Claude-only file assertions of spec 10 are restated.

criteria.action: keep resolving against `anthropic` rows only, accepting an optional `anthropic/` prefix, and serving the 10-REQ-3.4 fallback for an unlisted id
criteria.contract: `Lookup("qwen/qwen3.8-flash")` and `Lookup("qwen3.8:27b")` return false with ContextWindow 1000000 and MaxOutputTokens 128000; TS-10-12, TS-10-13 and TS-10-14 pass unchanged

criteria.action: keep the constant `Vendor = "anthropic"`, documented as the vendor `Lookup` resolves against
criteria.contract: `catalog.Vendor == "anthropic"`

criteria.action: list exactly the vendors anthropic, ollama and openrouter
criteria.contract: `Default().Vendors()` returns `[anthropic ollama openrouter]`; `KnownVendor` is true for those three and false for `openai`

criteria.action: import only `core` and the standard library and contain no file named `resolve.go` or `clamp.go`
criteria.contract: `go list -deps` of package catalog shows no module other than this module's `core`; neither file exists under catalog/

criteria.action: write no model id, limit or price of the new providers in non-test Go files outside the `catalog` package, and add no module requirement to go.mod
criteria.contract: a scan of non-test .go files outside catalog/ finds neither "qwen/qwen3.8-flash" nor "qwen3.8:27b"; `agent.go` still calls `catalog.Lookup(cfg.Model)`; go.mod's require set is unchanged

execution_paths.title: An embedder resolves the OpenRouter STANDARD tier and prices a usage

steps.action: parses the embedded catalog.json once through Default(), including the openrouter tiers block
canonicalises the provider, checks the model is non-empty and the effort empty, and recognises the STANDARD tier
reads the openrouter tier entry (qwen/qwen3.8-flash, medium) and returns a cloned row with Effort medium and Listed true
passes &sel.Model to provider.ComputeCost with a usage of 1,000,000 input tokens and receives a cost of 0.15 USD

execution_paths.title: An embedder names an unlisted Ollama model with an explicit effort

steps.action: canonicalises the provider to ollama and normalizes the effort to high
finds no ollama row for llama4:8b and builds the Ollama fallback descriptor
receives Selection{Provider ollama, Tier "", Model.ID llama4:8b, ContextWindow 32768, MaxOutputTokens 32768, zero prices, nil Efforts, Effort high, Listed false}

execution_paths.title: A maintainer's malformed tier block is rejected at load

steps.action: calls catalog.Parse with catalog bytes whose ollama STANDARD tier names effort xhigh, which the qwen3.8:27b row does not take
validates vendors and rows, then checks each tier against its row's thinking_level_map
returns a nil catalog and a *ParseError with Path vendors.ollama.tiers.STANDARD.effort that matches ErrCorruptCatalog

execution_paths.title: An existing embedder builds an agent through the unchanged Lookup

steps.action: calls agentkit.New with Model "claude-sonnet-5-5" and a faux provider client
calls catalog.Lookup(cfg.Model) against the 2026-10-21 embedded catalog
returns the unchanged anthropic row for claude-sonnet-5-5
runs one turn and sends the faux provider a request whose model is claude-sonnet-5-5 with a 128,000-or-row-defined output cap equal to the pre-spec value
